name: TWITTER 骓特 R18 (Racing ED) / Cyctrac
why_interesting: Official global and regional pages use TWITTER R18 (Racing ED), while the regional title retains Cyctrac; current mainland evidence identifies the retained electronic build as Shimano 105 Di2 R7170.

facts.frame_material: High-modulus T800/T1000 carbon frame with T800 carbon fork
facts.frame_construction: Aero road frame with full internal routing, T47x24 threaded bottom bracket, 12x100/12x142 thru axles, hydraulic discs and integrated carbon cockpit
facts.drivetrain: Shimano 105 Di2 R7170 electronic 2x12 / 24-speed with hydraulic disc brakes
facts.complete_weight_basis: Manufacturer and current JD listing weight for the R7170 build; size, pedals and measurement method are not stated
facts.wheels: RS T800/T1100 carbon wheels with 58 mm rims on the manufacturer's R7170 reference build
facts.tires: Maxxis Pursuer 700x28C fitted; this is not a published maximum
facts.stiffness_evidence: No exact-model numeric stiffness result or sufficiently specific independent frame-stiffness assessment was found across the 50-area sweep

missing: Maximum tire clearance and complete geometry table

source_note: TWITTER / 骓特 is the manufacturer identity. 'Cyctrac Carbon Road Bike' is retained by an official regional title, not treated as a separate maker. The exact current China index aligns the retained electronic lead with R7170 and 7.7 kg; fitted 28C tires do not establish maximum clearance.
